name: playpark
description: playpark LLC marketplace: playpark-core (shared base), dev-flow (issue-to-LGTM workflows + 7 dev-flow agents), playpark-skills (personal skills), host-exec (approved host execution outside the sandbox), meeting (auto meeting recording + local transcription + notes), bg-sessions (where each background Claude session is working), mosh-paste (fetch files pasted by path from the Mac you mosh in from)

plugins.name: playpark-core
plugins.description: Shared base for playpark plugins: _lib/common.sh, skill-retrospective journal telemetry, bin/journal

plugins.name: dev-flow
plugins.description: dev-flow: issue-to-LGTM dynamic workflows (dev-flow-run / pr-iterate-run / canary), 7 skills and 7 dev-flow agents, by playpark LLC

plugins.name: playpark-skills
plugins.description: playpark LLC personal skills: blog / sns / seo / media / ops utilities (requires playpark-core)

plugins.name: host-exec
plugins.description: Adds a tool that runs sandbox-blocked commands on the host after per-run approval, withholding secrets found in the output

plugins.name: meeting
plugins.description: Auto-records Zoom / Google Meet / Teams meetings on macOS (even ones you don't host), transcribes them locally with Whisper + pyannote speaker diarization, and turns them into meeting notes

plugins.name: bg-sessions
plugins.description: Shows which repo, worktree and branch each background Claude session is in, in a band above the prompt and a /bg-sessions list

plugins.name: mosh-paste
plugins.description: When a pasted path only exists on the Mac you mosh / ssh in from (a dropped screenshot), fetches the file over ssh and swaps in the local copy's path
